reviewCoverage.identity: Official Fashionz page, FashionTV-labelled brochure and exact branded plan pack read; not another Danube phase.
reviewCoverage.location: Own page and brochure map establish Jumeirah Village Triangle; a dedicated existing location mapping was not assumed. No exact coordinates or measured travel promise used.
reviewCoverage.residences: Official studio to three-bedroom mix and 788 apartments. Plan pack includes ordinary, executive and presidential variants; private pools not generalized.
reviewCoverage.areas: 18-page image-only plan contact reviewed; full numeric panels 3/9/12/14 at 1700 px visually read. Printed totals separated from apartment and balcony ranges; not recomputed by pairing extrema.
reviewCoverage.amenities: Own named rooftop pool lounge, spa, salon and fitness concept checked against actual 28-page brochure contact. No operating/contractual entitlement implied.
reviewCoverage.pricing: Official live heroAED 1513000 starting guide used; portal 830 K/830496 launch figures are older different reference, not adopted as current minimum. No selected-unit quote or inventory assumed.
reviewCoverage.payment: Own 30/70 headline conflicts retained 1%section/FAQ. PF 10/54/1/35 separate reference, with 100%arithmetic; no dated official milestone breakdown retrieved.
reviewCoverage.handover: Own heroJuly 2027 versus own FAQJuly 2026; PFJuly 2027 headline butMarch 2026 FAQ. Dates conflict; card null rather than treating elapsed forecasts as delivered. Own 30 September 2026 internal construction statement 47% reviewed; no completed handover inferred.
reviewCoverage.documents: Official 28-page brochure and public Madena 18-page branded unit plans successfully downloaded and visually checked. No forms, media changes or gated downloads. Subsequently retrieved the visible public official collateral floor-plan folder ZIP; compared actual own numeric panels. The broker PDF remains a direct PDF mirror link, not the primary numerical authority. Own English two-page factsheet retrieved from visible public ZIP; actual page 2 visually checked. Promotional financial/ROI claims excluded.

overview: Danube describes Fashionz as a FashionTV-branded residential development and lists 788 apartments. That project figure does not establish current developer or resale stock.
The amenity concept includes a rooftop pool lounge, spa, salon and branded fitness spaces. Public drawings distinguish ordinary and presidential layouts; private pools apply to selected units.
research.locationNote: Jumeirah Village Triangle, Dubai. Indicative marketing access routes are not measured walking distances or guaranteed journey times.
research.priceNote: Danube’s current project hero displays AED 1,513,000. Property Finder carries an older launch reference of about AED 830,000. Neither is a verified current offer for a selected unit; availability and terms need confirmation.
research.paymentNote: The developer hero displays 30/70, while its lower section and FAQ retain 1% monthly. Property Finder separately lists 10% booking, 54% construction, 1% at handover and 35% afterward. No current official milestone sheet reconciles these references. Confirm the exact unit’s contract, dates and charges.
research.handoverNote: Danube’s hero lists July 2027 but its FAQ says July 2026. Property Finder’s headline also says July 2027, while its FAQ retains March 2026. These estimates are inconsistent; actual completion and contractual delivery remain unverified.

facts.label: Layout-specific features
facts.value: The sampled Type A one-bedroom drawing includes an office; Type A two- and three-bedroom examples show a pool. These features are specific to the illustrated units.

facts.label: Dated developer progress
facts.value: Danube reports 47% overall progress from its internal inspection on 30 September 2026. This is a dated developer statement, not independent completion certification.

unresolved: Printed area ranges span multiple units and include balconies; they are not enclosed-space measurements or a complete availability schedule.
Current contractual completion, milestone dates, handover status, booking charges, parking, service/cooling fees, title terms and furniture inventory remain unverified.
Branded amenity concepts are not proof of operation, third-party service contracts or automatic access for every unit. Images remain illustrative.
